result.summary: The page looks mostly polished, but one key visual/functionality issue stands out: a loading spinner is overlaid on the main promotional card, suggesting an image or content is still loading and partially obscures the UI. There are also minor layout/content truncation issues.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, partially obscuring the food image. This suggests the image or card content is not fully loaded, creating a broken-looking state.
issues.suggestion: Ensure images and card data finish loading before removing the spinner, or show a skeleton/placeholder instead of an overlaid spinner on top of content.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Picco...') is truncated at the right edge, cutting off part of the name and image.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient right padding or use peek-layout spacing so the last visible card is not clipped at the screen edge.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Picco...' is ellipsized, making the full name unreadable without tapping into the detail view.
issues.suggestion: Consider allowing two-line titles or a tooltip/expansion to show the full restaurant name when space is limited.
